75: ## 2. PROBLEM & PURPOSE
76: 
77: ### Problem Statement
78: A speckit command tells a writer where to find authoring guidance, how a placeholder is treated and which files a packet holds. Six of those statements are now wrong or incomplete, and the same wrong text is copied into seven runtime trees. A weak model reads the command, follows the stale line and produces the defect that phases 2 to 5 just fixed in the templates.
79: 
80: ### Purpose
81: One corrected command and agent surface, with every runtime mirror regenerated from it, so a writer sees the same rule no matter which command or runtime it uses.
82: <!-- /ANCHOR:problem -->

87: ## 3. SCOPE
88: 
89: ### In Scope
90: - The full command and agent inventory in `plan.md` section 3: 7 speckit command docs, 6 workflow assets, 6 presentation assets, 3 doctor spec-kit files, 8 doctor update files, 1 route manifest, 3 create-goal assets and 11 agents. Twelve of those files carry a change.
91: - 27 exact text rows: 21 audit rows on `.skilled` sources and 6 mirror rows on `.claude/agents`.
92: - Regeneration of every runtime mirror tree from those sources.
93: - Eight read-only mirror checks and three read-only doctor:speckit checks.
94: - One suite comparison against the phase start, one strict validation and one read-only frontier review.
95: 
96: ### Out of Scope
97: - Template, validator, runtime source and reference edits. Phases 2 to 5 and 7 own those.
98: - Implementing `check-example-drift.sh` or `check-card-sync.sh`. Phase 4 creates the first and phase 5 creates the second. This phase only names them in commands.
99: - Release, update and compat engine behavior. `/doctor:update` is audited for stale statements and changed only if the audit finds one.
100: - Hand edits to a generated mirror. The generators own those files.
101: 
102: ### Files to Change
103: 
104: | File Path | Change Type | Description |
105: |-----------|-------------|-------------|
106: | `.skilled/commands/speckit/plan.md`, `implement.md`, `complete.md` | Modify | Name the two guard scripts in the validation summary |
107: | `.skilled/commands/speckit/assets/speckit-plan.yaml` | Modify | Add the guard command, fix the placeholder classifier, point the writer at a filled example |
108: | `.skilled/commands/speckit/assets/speckit-implement.yaml` | Modify | Add the guard command |
109: | `.skilled/commands/speckit/assets/speckit-complete.yaml` | Modify | Add the guard command, fix the placeholder classifier, name the authoring card first |
110: | `.skilled/commands/speckit/assets/speckit-resume-auto.yaml`, `speckit-resume-confirm.yaml` | Modify | Drop the retired checklist doc from the continuity ladder |
111: | `.skilled/agents/markdown.md` | Modify | Point the spec-doc row at the card and a filled example |
112: | `.skilled/agents/orchestrate.md`, `code.md`, `context.md` | Modify | Drop the retired checklist doc |
113: | `.claude/agents/markdown.md`, `orchestrate.md`, `code.md`, `context.md` | Modify | Same body text, so the agent mirror check stays green |
114: | `.codex/agents/*.toml`, `.codex/prompts/*.md`, `.pi/agents/*.md`, `.pi/prompts/*.md` | Regenerate | Generated mirrors of the corrected sources |
115: | `scratch/audit/*`, `scratch/mirrors/*`, `scratch/suite-*.txt`, `scratch/review/*` | Create | Evidence for every gate |

148: ## 5. SUCCESS CRITERIA
149: 
150: - **SC-001**: A writer who opens any speckit command sees the authoring card named before the long references and the filled example named before the template source.
151: - **SC-002**: A grep for the retired checklist doc over the command and agent surface prints nothing, so no reader is sent to a file that no longer exists.
152: - **SC-003**: Every runtime mirror check exits 0 on the corrected tree, so no runtime carries a different rule from another.

158: ## 6. RISKS & DEPENDENCIES
159: 
160: | Type | Item | Impact | Mitigation |
161: |------|------|--------|------------|
162: | Dependency | Authoring card and two guard scripts from phases 2 and 5 | The A1 rows and the A5 rows cannot be applied | Every dependent row carries a pre-check command, and a failed pre-check records the row as `SKIP-MISSING` |
163: | Dependency | Phase 1 ledger | A census row that this phase owns could be missed | `tasks.md` T010 reads every ledger row with `owner_phase` 006 and records it against the audit table |
164: | Risk | An agent body edit leaves the Claude sibling behind | `check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs` fails and the phase blocks | The 6 mirror rows apply the same text to `.claude/agents`, and the check runs before the suite |
165: | Risk | A mirror generator rewrites an unrelated file | The scope check reports a path no row explains | The scope check in `tasks.md` T011 compares the changed set with the row file set and the generated set |
166: | Risk | The trigger index is already stale at the phase start | A literal freshness gate would fail for a reason this phase did not cause | T009 compares the staleness set before and after, not the freshness bit |
167: <!-- /ANCHOR:risks -->
168: 
169: ---
170: 
171: 
172: ## 7. NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
173: 
174: ### Performance
175: - **NFR-P01**: The 27 rows are applied by script in one pass, with no model call. The only model call in the phase is the single read-only frontier review.
176: 
177: ### Security
178: - **NFR-S01**: No brief, row or scratch file carries a credential, token or key. The review runs with a read-only sandbox.
179: 
180: ### Reliability
181: - **NFR-R01**: A second apply of any row fails, because the locator is gone. A rerun therefore cannot edit a file twice.
182: 
183: ---
184: 
185: ## 8. EDGE CASES
186: 
187: ### Data Boundaries
188: - Empty input: a row whose `locator` count is 0 is recorded as `SKIP-GONE` and the phase continues, because an earlier phase may have fixed the same line.
189: - Maximum length: a row whose `expected_text` holds more than one line is applied as one replacement, and the JSONL encoder writes the line breaks as `\n`.
190: 
191: ### Error Scenarios
192: - External service failure: the frontier review is the only external call. A provider error is recorded with its stderr, and REQ-008 stays open.
193: - Network timeout: the review is retried once, then recorded as skipped.
194: - Pre-check failure: a row whose pre-check command exits non-zero is recorded as `SKIP-MISSING` and is not applied.
195: 
196: ---
197: 
198: ## 9. COMPLEXITY ASSESSMENT
199: 
200: | Dimension | Score | Triggers |
201: |-----------|-------|----------|
202: | Scope | 10/25 | Files: 12 authored, 4 Claude siblings, 4 generated trees. Systems: commands, agents, mirrors |
203: | Risk | 5/25 | Auth: N, API: N, Breaking: N |
204: | Research | 8/20 | The audit was done at authoring time against the real tree |
205: | Multi-Agent | 4/15 | Workstreams: 1 conductor, 1 review |
206: | Coordination | 8/15 | Dependencies: phases 1, 4 and 5 |
207: | **Total** | **35/100** | **Level 3** |
208: 
209: ---
210: 
211: ## 10. RISK MATRIX
212: 
213: | Risk ID | Description | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
214: |---------|-------------|--------|------------|------------|
215: | R-001 | A row is applied to the wrong line because the text drifted | H | L | The applier refuses unless the locator occurs exactly once, and T004 checks all 27 counts before T006 |
216: | R-002 | A mirror is hand-edited and the next generator run reverts it | M | L | T008 runs the generators, and the checks prove the generated tree matches the source |
217: | R-003 | The pre-existing stale trigger index is mistaken for a defect of this phase | M | M | T009 compares the staleness set before and after |
218: 
219: ---
220: 
221: ## 11. USER STORIES
222: 
223: ### US-001: The short card comes first (Priority: P0)
224: 
225: **As a** weak model writing a spec doc, **I want** the command I am following to name the short authoring card and a filled example, **so that** I do not open a 1,200-line guide or a template with unfilled sections.
226: 
227: **Acceptance criteria:** see `acceptance-criteria.md` (rows referencing this story).
228: 
229: ---
230: 
231: ### US-002: Every runtime agrees (Priority: P0)
232: 
233: **As the** operator, **I want** every runtime tree regenerated from one corrected source, **so that** a writer on Claude, Codex, Pi or OpenCode reads the same rule.
234: 
235: **Acceptance criteria:** see `acceptance-criteria.md` (rows referencing this story).
236: 
237: ---
238: 
239: <!-- ANCHOR:questions -->
240: ## 12. OPEN QUESTIONS
241: 
242: - None that block this phase. Every choice it needs is frozen in `goal.md` section 1.
243: - The trigger index is stale at the phase start for reasons outside this phase. T009 records the exact set and does not try to fix it.
244: - Phase 1 records `suite-start.txt` before any template changes. Phases 2 to 5 add tests, so T012 compares against the phase start and records the cumulative delta as information.
245: <!-- /ANCHOR:questions -->
246: 
247: ---
248: 
249: ## RELATED DOCUMENTS
250: 
251: - **Implementation Plan**: See `plan.md`
252: - **Task Breakdown**: See `tasks.md`
253: - **Verification Checklist**: See `tasks.md`
254: - **Decision Records**: See `plan.md` section L3: ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORD
255:

172: ## 7. NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
173: 
174: ### Performance
175: - **NFR-P01**: The 27 rows are applied by script in one pass, with no model call. The only model call in the phase is the single read-only frontier review.

177: ### Security
178: - **NFR-S01**: No brief, row or scratch file carries a credential, token or key. The review runs with a read-only sandbox.
179: 
180: ### Reliability
181: - **NFR-R01**: A second apply of any row fails, because the locator is gone. A rerun therefore cannot edit a file twice.

185: ## 8. EDGE CASES
186: 
187: ### Data Boundaries
188: - Empty input: a row whose `locator` count is 0 is recorded as `SKIP-GONE` and the phase continues, because an earlier phase may have fixed the same line.

192: - External service failure: the frontier review is the only external call. A provider error is recorded with its stderr, and REQ-008 stays open.
193: - Network timeout: the review is retried once, then recorded as skipped.
194: - Pre-check failure: a row whose pre-check command exits non-zero is recorded as `SKIP-MISSING` and is not applied.

54: ### Pattern

57: ### Key Components
58: - **Lane A worker**: reads `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/templates/` except `examples/`.
59: - **Lane B worker**: reads `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/templates/examples/`.
60: - **Lane C worker**: reads `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/references/templates/`, `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/references/workflows/` and `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/SKILL.md`.

63: ### Ledger schema (frozen)
64: 
65: One JSON object per line. All ten fields are required strings.
66: 
67: | Field | Meaning |
68: |-------|---------|
69: | `id` | `L-<lane>-<NNN>`, for example `L-B-004` |
70: | `lane` | `A`, `B` or `C` |
71: | `file` | Repository-relative path of the file with the defect |
72: | `locator` | Exact text that occurs once in that file and marks the defect |
73: | `defect_class` | One of the eight classes below |
74: | `observed` | What is there now, in one sentence |
75: | `expected_text` | The exact replacement text, or `DELETE FILE`, or `OWNED BY PHASE` when a later phase rewrites the area |
76: | `owner_phase` | `002`, `003`, `004`, `005`, `006` or `041-006` |
77: | `evidence_cmd` | One shell command, run from the repository root |
78: | `evidence_expect` | The exact text or count that command prints while the defect exists |
79: 
80: ### Defect classes and detection commands
81: 
82: Run each from the repository root. `S=.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit`.
83: 
84: | Class | Detection command | Owner |
85: |-------|-------------------|-------|

88: | `unresolved-placeholder` | `rg -n '<spec-folder>\|<path>\|<track>' <dir>` on prose lines outside code blocks | 002 or 041-006 |
89: | `self-contradiction` | Read the file. Report two lines that state opposite rules for the same thing | 002 |

92: | `unenforced-hint` | `rg -c '\[[A-Za-z][^]\[]{2,}\]' $S/templates/core/*.tmpl` | 003 |
93: | `doc-code-mismatch` | `rg -n '\[PLACEHOLDER\]' $S/references` and any reference sentence that names a rule `validate.sh` does not run | 003 |

97: | # | File | Locator | Class | Owner |

99: | 1 | `$S/templates/examples/level-2/tasks.md` and 17 other example docs | `description: "including effort estimates and explicit verification tasks for each feature. -->"` | `leaked-description` | 002 |
100: | 2 | `$S/templates/examples/level-2/tasks.md`, `level-3/tasks.md`, `level-3+/tasks.md` | `- [x] Checklist.md fully verified` | `stale-reference` | 002 |
101: | 3 | `$S/references/workflows/spec-folder-write-recipe.md` | `  <spec-folder>` | `unresolved-placeholder` | 041-006 |

293: ## AI EXECUTION PROTOCOL
294: 
295: Written for the executing swarm. Follow each rule as written. Where a rule and your own judgment disagree, follow the rule and record the disagreement in `goal.md` section 4.
296: 
297: ### Roles
298: - **Conductor**: one DeepSeek V4.1 Flash max session that is not itself running inside OpenCode, because `cli-opencode` refuses a dispatch from inside OpenCode. It dispatches workers, runs every verify command, edits only this phase folder, and keeps `goal.md` section 4 current.
299: - **Worker**: one `opencode2 run` dispatch on `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max`. One worker does one lane or one baseline run, then stops.
300: - **Reviewer**: one read-only frontier review through `cli-codex` at phase close. It writes nothing.
301: 
302: ### Pre-Task Checklist
303: - [ ] Read this phase's `spec.md`, this plan and `tasks.md` before the first dispatch
304: - [ ] Read `.skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/cli-opencode/SKILL.md` sections 3 and 4 before composing the first worker command
305: - [ ] Confirm the working directory is the build worktree recorded in `../goal.md` section 4, never the main checkout
306: - [ ] Confirm `opencode2 models --standalone` lists `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`
307: - [ ] Save every brief to `scratch/briefs/<task-id>.txt` before dispatching it
308: 
309: ### Execution Rules
310: 
311: | Rule | Requirement |
312: |------|-------------|
313: | TASK-SEQ | Run tasks in ID order. Tasks marked `[P]` may run together, at most three at once, and only when no two write the same file |
314: | TASK-SCOPE | A worker writes only the paths under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS in its brief |
315: | TASK-VERIFY | The conductor runs the task's verify command and reads both its output and its exit status before marking the task `[x]` |
316: | TASK-LOCATE | Find text by its exact content, never by a line number |
317: | TASK-BANNED | Workers never run `git commit`, `git push`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git branch`, `git reset`, `git stash`, `generate-context.js` or `/speckit:save` |
318: 
319: ### Worker Brief Skeleton
320: 
321: Every brief starts with this block, word for word, with the two paths filled in:
322: 
323: ```text
324: GATE 3 IS PRE-RESOLVED. DO NOT ASK THE DOCUMENTATION-SCOPE QUESTION.
325: 
326: You are a non-interactive dispatched worker. AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 and
327: SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 are set in your environment, which this repository's AGENTS.md
328: defines as the autonomous child-dispatch exemption: the spec-folder question is pre-resolved
329: and MUST NOT be asked. No answer can reach you, because nobody is at a prompt.
330: 
331: Your write authority is already bound. The spec folder is:
332:   specs/system-speckit/054-weak-model-spec-authoring/001-template-drift-census-and-baseline
333: 
334: Proceed directly to the work. Do not print A/B/C/D options. Do not stop to confirm anything.
335: A failed edit match means a stale anchor: re-read the file and retry; halt only after three
336: failures on the same file.
337: Your task is complete only when files exist on disk and the verification command has been run.
338: 
339: ROLE: You are a read-only auditor. You read files, run read-only commands and write one
340: result file. Your output is checked line by line by a script.
341: 
342: ALLOWED WRITE PATHS:
343:   <the one file this task names>
344: 
345: BANNED OPERATIONS: git commit, git push, git checkout, git switch, git branch, git reset,
346: git stash, rm, mv, create.sh outside the task's stated command, generate-context.js,
347: /speckit:save, and any edit to a file not listed under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS.
348: ```
349: 
350: The role line is a focused persona summary in place of a full agent file, the small-context exception that `cli-opencode` rule 18 allows. It is declared here as that exception.
351: 
352: ### Dispatch Command
353: 
354: ```bash
355: cd "$WORKTREE" && SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 opencode2 run --standalone \
356:   -m llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max --format json \
357:   "$(cat "$PHASE/scratch/briefs/$TASK.txt")" </dev/null > "$PHASE/scratch/runs/$TASK.jsonl" 2>&1 &
358: PID=$!; wait "$PID"; kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -P "$PID" 2>/dev/null
359: ```
360: 
361: `PHASE` is this folder's path and `WORKTREE` is the build worktree. Never kill by a name pattern. Kill only the captured PID.
362: 
363: ### Status Reporting Format

367: ### Blocked Task Protocol
368: 1. Restore any file the task changed with `git restore --source=<start commit> -- <file>`.
369: 2. Mark the task `[B]` in `tasks.md` with the failing command and the first line of its output.
370: 3. Re-dispatch at most twice with the brief corrected for what failed. After the third failure on the same task, leave it `[B]` and continue with the next task.
371: 4. Stop the phase when two tasks are blocked, and write `STOP` with both task IDs in `goal.md` section 4.

376: ## L3: ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORD
377: 
378: ### ADR-001: Keep only rows that reproduce
379: 
380: **Status**: Accepted
381: 
382: **Context**: A DeepSeek worker asked to find defects will also report things that are not defects.
383: 
384: **Decision**: A lane row enters `ledger.jsonl` only when the conductor runs its `evidence_cmd` on the unchanged tree and the output contains its `evidence_expect`. The `self-contradiction` class has no command, so those rows go to the frontier review instead.
385: 
386: **Consequences**:
387: - Phase 2 receives no row it cannot reproduce.
388: - A real defect the worker described badly is dropped. The frontier review reads the source files again to catch those.
389: 
390: **Alternatives Rejected**:
391: - Trusting lane output as written: it puts unconfirmed findings into a repair phase that edits shared templates.
392: 
393: ### ADR-002: One fixed authoring task, three runs, run in a throwaway track
394: 
395: **Status**: Accepted
396: 
397: **Context**: The baseline must be rerun unchanged in phase 8, and one run of a sampling model is one sample.
398: 
399: **Decision**: The task text in `tasks.md` T009 is frozen. It runs three times per side. Each run creates `specs/zz-bench-authoring/`, and the conductor deletes that directory after measuring.
400: 
401: **Consequences**:
402: - Phase 8 compares like with like and reports a range.
403: - Three runs cannot detect a small effect. Phase 8 reports the range, not a significance claim.
404: 
405: **Alternatives Rejected**:
406: - Measuring by a frontier model's judgment of quality: one model is one opinion, and the five metrics are commands.

293: ## AI EXECUTION PROTOCOL
294: 
295: Written for the executing swarm. Follow each rule as written. Where a rule and your own judgment disagree, follow the rule and record the disagreement in `goal.md` section 4.
296: 
297: ### Roles
298: - **Conductor**: one DeepSeek V4.1 Flash max session that is not itself running inside OpenCode, because `cli-opencode` refuses a dispatch from inside OpenCode. It dispatches workers, runs every verify command, edits only this phase folder, and keeps `goal.md` section 4 current.
299: - **Worker**: one `opencode2 run` dispatch on `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max`. One worker does one lane or one baseline run, then stops.
300: - **Reviewer**: one read-only frontier review through `cli-codex` at phase close. It writes nothing.
301: 
302: ### Pre-Task Checklist
303: - [ ] Read this phase's `spec.md`, this plan and `tasks.md` before the first dispatch
304: - [ ] Read `.skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/cli-opencode/SKILL.md` sections 3 and 4 before composing the first worker command
305: - [ ] Confirm the working directory is the build worktree recorded in `../goal.md` section 4, never the main checkout
306: - [ ] Confirm `opencode2 models --standalone` lists `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`
307: - [ ] Save every brief to `scratch/briefs/<task-id>.txt` before dispatching it
308: 
309: ### Execution Rules
310: 
311: | Rule | Requirement |
312: |------|-------------|
313: | TASK-SEQ | Run tasks in ID order. Tasks marked `[P]` may run together, at most three at once, and only when no two write the same file |
314: | TASK-SCOPE | A worker writes only the paths under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS in its brief |
315: | TASK-VERIFY | The conductor runs the task's verify command and reads both its output and its exit status before marking the task `[x]` |
316: | TASK-LOCATE | Find text by its exact content, never by a line number |
317: | TASK-BANNED | Workers never run `git commit`, `git push`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git branch`, `git reset`, `git stash`, `generate-context.js` or `/speckit:save` |
318: 
319: ### Worker Brief Skeleton
320: 
321: Every brief starts with this block, word for word, with the two paths filled in:
322: 
323: ```text
324: GATE 3 IS PRE-RESOLVED. DO NOT ASK THE DOCUMENTATION-SCOPE QUESTION.
325: 
326: You are a non-interactive dispatched worker. AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 and
327: SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 are set in your environment, which this repository's AGENTS.md
328: defines as the autonomous child-dispatch exemption: the spec-folder question is pre-resolved
329: and MUST NOT be asked. No answer can reach you, because nobody is at a prompt.
330: 
331: Your write authority is already bound. The spec folder is:
332:   specs/system-speckit/054-weak-model-spec-authoring/001-template-drift-census-and-baseline
333: 
334: Proceed directly to the work. Do not print A/B/C/D options. Do not stop to confirm anything.
335: A failed edit match means a stale anchor: re-read the file and retry; halt only after three
336: failures on the same file.
337: Your task is complete only when files exist on disk and the verification command has been run.
338: 
339: ROLE: You are a read-only auditor. You read files, run read-only commands and write one
340: result file. Your output is checked line by line by a script.
341: 
342: ALLOWED WRITE PATHS:
343:   <the one file this task names>
344: 
345: BANNED OPERATIONS: git commit, git push, git checkout, git switch, git branch, git reset,
346: git stash, rm, mv, create.sh outside the task's stated command, generate-context.js,
347: /speckit:save, and any edit to a file not listed under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS.
348: ```
349: 
350: The role line is a focused persona summary in place of a full agent file, the small-context exception that `cli-opencode` rule 18 allows. It is declared here as that exception.
351: 
352: ### Dispatch Command
353: 
354: ```bash
355: cd "$WORKTREE" && SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 opencode2 run --standalone \
356:   -m llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max --format json \
357:   "$(cat "$PHASE/scratch/briefs/$TASK.txt")" </dev/null > "$PHASE/scratch/runs/$TASK.jsonl" 2>&1 &
358: PID=$!; wait "$PID"; kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -P "$PID" 2>/dev/null
359: ```
360: 
361: `PHASE` is this folder's path and `WORKTREE` is the build worktree. Never kill by a name pattern. Kill only the captured PID.
362: 
363: ### Status Reporting Format
364: 
365: `[T###] DONE | BLOCKED - one line of evidence`, written as a row in the progress table of `goal.md` section 4.
366: 
367: ### Blocked Task Protocol
368: 1. Restore any file the task changed with `git restore --source=<start commit> -- <file>`.
369: 2. Mark the task `[B]` in `tasks.md` with the failing command and the first line of its output.
370: 3. Re-dispatch at most twice with the brief corrected for what failed. After the third failure on the same task, leave it `[B]` and continue with the next task.
371: 4. Stop the phase when two tasks are blocked, and write `STOP` with both task IDs in `goal.md` section 4.

376: ## L3: ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORD
377: 
378: ### ADR-001: Keep only rows that reproduce
379: 
380: **Status**: Accepted
381: 
382: **Context**: A DeepSeek worker asked to find defects will also report things that are not defects.
383: 
384: **Decision**: A lane row enters `ledger.jsonl` only when the conductor runs its `evidence_cmd` on the unchanged tree and the output contains its `evidence_expect`. The `self-contradiction` class has no command, so those rows go to the frontier review instead.
385: 
386: **Consequences**:
387: - Phase 2 receives no row it cannot reproduce.
388: - A real defect the worker described badly is dropped. The frontier review reads the source files again to catch those.
389: 
390: **Alternatives Rejected**:
391: - Trusting lane output as written: it puts unconfirmed findings into a repair phase that edits shared templates.
392: 
393: ### ADR-002: One fixed authoring task, three runs, run in a throwaway track
394: 
395: **Status**: Accepted
396: 
397: **Context**: The baseline must be rerun unchanged in phase 8, and one run of a sampling model is one sample.
398: 
399: **Decision**: The task text in `tasks.md` T009 is frozen. It runs three times per side. Each run creates `specs/zz-bench-authoring/`, and the conductor deletes that directory after measuring.
400: 
401: **Consequences**:
402: - Phase 8 compares like with like and reports a range.
403: - Three runs cannot detect a small effect. Phase 8 reports the range, not a significance claim.
404: 
405: **Alternatives Rejected**:
406: - Measuring by a frontier model's judgment of quality: one model is one opinion, and the five metrics are commands.

52: ## 3. ARCHITECTURE
53: 
54: ### Pattern
55: Fan-out of read-only lanes, then a deterministic reduce by the conductor.
56: 
57: ### Key Components
58: - **Lane A worker**: reads `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/templates/` except `examples/`.
59: - **Lane B worker**: reads `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/templates/examples/`.
60: - **Lane C worker**: reads `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/references/templates/`, `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/references/workflows/` and `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/SKILL.md`.
61: - **Conductor**: merges lane files, re-runs evidence, writes `ledger.jsonl`, runs the baseline.

63: ### Ledger schema (frozen)
64: 
65: One JSON object per line. All ten fields are required strings.
66: 
67: | Field | Meaning |
68: |-------|---------|
69: | `id` | `L-<lane>-<NNN>`, for example `L-B-004` |
70: | `lane` | `A`, `B` or `C` |
71: | `file` | Repository-relative path of the file with the defect |
72: | `locator` | Exact text that occurs once in that file and marks the defect |
73: | `defect_class` | One of the eight classes below |
74: | `observed` | What is there now, in one sentence |
75: | `expected_text` | The exact replacement text, or `DELETE FILE`, or `OWNED BY PHASE` when a later phase rewrites the area |
76: | `owner_phase` | `002`, `003`, `004`, `005`, `006` or `041-006` |
77: | `evidence_cmd` | One shell command, run from the repository root |
78: | `evidence_expect` | The exact text or count that command prints while the defect exists |
79: 
80: ### Defect classes and detection commands
81: 
82: Run each from the repository root. `S=.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit`.
83: 
84: | Class | Detection command | Owner |
85: |-------|-------------------|-------|
86: | `leaked-description` | `rg -n '^description: "([a-z]|.*-->)' $S/templates` | 002 |
87: | `stale-reference` | `rg -o --no-filename '\.skilled/[A-Za-z0-9_./+-]+' <dir> \| sort -u \| while read p; do test -e "$p" \|\| echo "MISSING $p"; done` and `rg -n -i 'checklist\.md' <dir>` | 002 |
88: | `unresolved-placeholder` | `rg -n '<spec-folder>\|<path>\|<track>' <dir>` on prose lines outside code blocks | 002 or 041-006 |
89: | `self-contradiction` | Read the file. Report two lines that state opposite rules for the same thing | 002 |
90: | `dead-file` | For each non-markdown file at `$S/templates/` top level: `rg -l --hidden "<basename>" .skilled --glob '!<that file>' \| wc -l` prints `0` | 002 |
91: | `gate-anchor-crossing` | `awk 'BEGIN{d=0} /<!-- IF /{d++} /<!-- \/IF -->/{d--} /<!-- ANCHOR:/{match($0,/ANCHOR:[a-z0-9-]+/); a[substr($0,RSTART+7,RLENGTH-7)]=d} /<!-- \/ANCHOR:/{match($0,/ANCHOR:[a-z0-9-]+/); n=substr($0,RSTART+7,RLENGTH-7); if (a[n]!=d) print FILENAME":"NR": anchor "n" opens at "a[n]" closes at "d}' <file.tmpl>` | 004 |
92: | `unenforced-hint` | `rg -c '\[[A-Za-z][^]\[]{2,}\]' $S/templates/core/*.tmpl` | 003 |
93: | `doc-code-mismatch` | `rg -n '\[PLACEHOLDER\]' $S/references` and any reference sentence that names a rule `validate.sh` does not run | 003 |

293: ## AI EXECUTION PROTOCOL
294: 
295: Written for the executing swarm. Follow each rule as written. Where a rule and your own judgment disagree, follow the rule and record the disagreement in `goal.md` section 4.
296: 
297: ### Roles
298: - **Conductor**: one DeepSeek V4.1 Flash max session that is not itself running inside OpenCode, because `cli-opencode` refuses a dispatch from inside OpenCode. It dispatches workers, runs every verify command, edits only this phase folder, and keeps `goal.md` section 4 current.
299: - **Worker**: one `opencode2 run` dispatch on `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max`. One worker does one lane or one baseline run, then stops.
300: - **Reviewer**: one read-only frontier review through `cli-codex` at phase close. It writes nothing.
301: 
302: ### Pre-Task Checklist
303: - [ ] Read this phase's `spec.md`, this plan and `tasks.md` before the first dispatch
304: - [ ] Read `.skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/cli-opencode/SKILL.md` sections 3 and 4 before composing the first worker command
305: - [ ] Confirm the working directory is the build worktree recorded in `../goal.md` section 4, never the main checkout
306: - [ ] Confirm `opencode2 models --standalone` lists `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`
307: - [ ] Save every brief to `scratch/briefs/<task-id>.txt` before dispatching it
308: 
309: ### Execution Rules
310: 
311: | Rule | Requirement |
312: |------|-------------|
313: | TASK-SEQ | Run tasks in ID order. Tasks marked `[P]` may run together, at most three at once, and only when no two write the same file |
314: | TASK-SCOPE | A worker writes only the paths under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS in its brief |
315: | TASK-VERIFY | The conductor runs the task's verify command and reads both its output and its exit status before marking the task `[x]` |
316: | TASK-LOCATE | Find text by its exact content, never by a line number |
317: | TASK-BANNED | Workers never run `git commit`, `git push`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git branch`, `git reset`, `git stash`, `generate-context.js` or `/speckit:save` |
318: 
319: ### Worker Brief Skeleton
320: 
321: Every brief starts with this block, word for word, with the two paths filled in:
322: 
323: ```text
324: GATE 3 IS PRE-RESOLVED. DO NOT ASK THE DOCUMENTATION-SCOPE QUESTION.
325: 
326: You are a non-interactive dispatched worker. AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 and
327: SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 are set in your environment, which this repository's AGENTS.md
328: defines as the autonomous child-dispatch exemption: the spec-folder question is pre-resolved
329: and MUST NOT be asked. No answer can reach you, because nobody is at a prompt.
330: 
331: Your write authority is already bound. The spec folder is:
332:   specs/system-speckit/054-weak-model-spec-authoring/001-template-drift-census-and-baseline
333: 
334: Proceed directly to the work. Do not print A/B/C/D options. Do not stop to confirm anything.
335: A failed edit match means a stale anchor: re-read the file and retry; halt only after three
336: failures on the same file.
337: Your task is complete only when files exist on disk and the verification command has been run.
338: 
339: ROLE: You are a read-only auditor. You read files, run read-only commands and write one
340: result file. Your output is checked line by line by a script.
341: 
342: ALLOWED WRITE PATHS:
343:   <the one file this task names>
344: 
345: BANNED OPERATIONS: git commit, git push, git checkout, git switch, git branch, git reset,
346: git stash, rm, mv, create.sh outside the task's stated command, generate-context.js,
347: /speckit:save, and any edit to a file not listed under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS.
348: ```
349: 
350: The role line is a focused persona summary in place of a full agent file, the small-context exception that `cli-opencode` rule 18 allows. It is declared here as that exception.
351: 
352: ### Dispatch Command
353: 
354: ```bash
355: cd "$WORKTREE" && SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 opencode2 run --standalone \
356:   -m llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max --format json \
357:   "$(cat "$PHASE/scratch/briefs/$TASK.txt")" </dev/null > "$PHASE/scratch/runs/$TASK.jsonl" 2>&1 &
358: PID=$!; wait "$PID"; kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -P "$PID" 2>/dev/null
359: ```

361: `PHASE` is this folder's path and `WORKTREE` is the build worktree. Never kill by a name pattern. Kill only the captured PID.

369: 2. Mark the task `[B]` in `tasks.md` with the failing command and the first line of its output.
370: 3. Re-dispatch at most twice with the brief corrected for what failed. After the third failure on the same task, leave it `[B]` and continue with the next task.
371: 4. Stop the phase when two tasks are blocked, and write `STOP` with both task IDs in `goal.md` section 4.

376: ## L3: ARCHITECTURE DECISION RECORD
377: 
378: ### ADR-001: Keep only rows that reproduce
379: 
380: **Status**: Accepted
381: 
382: **Context**: A DeepSeek worker asked to find defects will also report things that are not defects.
383: 
384: **Decision**: A lane row enters `ledger.jsonl` only when the conductor runs its `evidence_cmd` on the unchanged tree and the output contains its `evidence_expect`. The `self-contradiction` class has no command, so those rows go to the frontier review instead.
385: 
386: **Consequences**:
387: - Phase 2 receives no row it cannot reproduce.
388: - A real defect the worker described badly is dropped. The frontier review reads the source files again to catch those.
389: 
390: **Alternatives Rejected**:
391: - Trusting lane output as written: it puts unconfirmed findings into a repair phase that edits shared templates.
392: 
393: ### ADR-002: One fixed authoring task, three runs, run in a throwaway track
394: 
395: **Status**: Accepted
396: 
397: **Context**: The baseline must be rerun unchanged in phase 8, and one run of a sampling model is one sample.
398: 
399: **Decision**: The task text in `tasks.md` T009 is frozen. It runs three times per side. Each run creates `specs/zz-bench-authoring/`, and the conductor deletes that directory after measuring.
400: 
401: **Consequences**:
402: - Phase 8 compares like with like and reports a range.
403: - Three runs cannot detect a small effect. Phase 8 reports the range, not a significance claim.
404: 
405: **Alternatives Rejected**:
406: - Measuring by a frontier model's judgment of quality: one model is one opinion, and the five metrics are commands.

297: ### Roles
298: - **Conductor**: one DeepSeek V4.1 Flash max session that is not itself running inside OpenCode, because `cli-opencode` refuses a dispatch from inside OpenCode. It dispatches workers, runs every verify command, edits only this phase folder, and keeps `goal.md` section 4 current.
299: - **Worker**: one `opencode2 run` dispatch on `llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017#max`. One worker does one lane or one baseline run, then stops.
300: - **Reviewer**: one read-only frontier review through `cli-codex` at phase close. It writes nothing.

304: - [ ] Read `.skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/cli-opencode/SKILL.md` sections 3 and 4 before composing the first worker command

309: ### Execution Rules
310: 
311: | Rule | Requirement |
312: |------|-------------|
313: | TASK-SEQ | Run tasks in ID order. Tasks marked `[P]` may run together, at most three at once, and only when no two write the same file |
314: | TASK-SCOPE | A worker writes only the paths under ALLOWED WRITE PATHS in its brief |
315: | TASK-VERIFY | The conductor runs the task's verify command and reads both its output and its exit status before marking the task `[x]` |
316: | TASK-LOCATE | Find text by its exact content, never by a line number |
317: | TASK-BANNED | Workers never run `git commit`, `git push`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git branch`, `git reset`, `git stash`, `generate-context.js` or `/speckit:save` |

321: Every brief starts with this block, word for word, with the two paths filled in:
322: 
323: ```text
324: GATE 3 IS PRE-RESOLVED. DO NOT ASK THE DOCUMENTATION-SCOPE QUESTION.
325: 
326: You are a non-interactive dispatched worker. AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 and
327: SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0 are set in your environment, which this repository's AGENTS.md
328: defines as the autonomous child-dispatch exemption: the spec-folder question is pre-resolved
329: and MUST NOT be asked. No answer can reach you, because nobody is at a prompt.

332:   specs/system-speckit/054-weak-model-spec-authoring/001-template-drift-census-and-baseline

335: A failed edit match means a stale anchor: re-read the file and retry; halt only after three
336: failures on the same file.
337: Your task is complete only when files exist on disk and the verification command has been run.

378: ### ADR-001: Keep only rows that reproduce
379: 
380: **Status**: Accepted
381: 
382: **Context**: A DeepSeek worker asked to find defects will also report things that are not defects.
383: 
384: **Decision**: A lane row enters `ledger.jsonl` only when the conductor runs its `evidence_cmd` on the unchanged tree and the output contains its `evidence_expect`. The `self-contradiction` class has no command, so those rows go to the frontier review instead.
385: 
386: **Consequences**:
387: - Phase 2 receives no row it cannot reproduce.
388: - A real defect the worker described badly is dropped. The frontier review reads the source files again to catch those.
389: 
390: **Alternatives Rejected**:
391: - Trusting lane output as written: it puts unconfirmed findings into a repair phase that edits shared templates.

394: 
395: **Status**: Accepted
396: 
397: **Context**: The baseline must be rerun unchanged in phase 8, and one run of a sampling model is one sample.
398: 
399: **Decision**: The task text in `tasks.md` T009 is frozen. It runs three times per side. Each run creates `specs/zz-bench-authoring/`, and the conductor deletes that directory after measuring.

402: - Phase 8 compares like with like and reports a range.
403: - Three runs cannot detect a small effect. Phase 8 reports the range, not a significance claim.

406: - Measuring by a frontier model's judgment of quality: one model is one opinion, and the five metrics are commands.
